source_preview:
Job Description: Wireframing and Figma Design - Mumbai

Role Overview
We are seeking a skilled Wireframing and Figma Designer to join our team and help us create
intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces. The ideal candidate is a creative problem-
solver with a strong understanding of user experience (UX) principles and a proficiency in
Figma.

Responsibilities

•
Wireframing:
o Create low-fidelity and high-fidelity wireframes to visualize the structure and
layout of digital products.
o Collaborate with UX researchers and designers to understand user needs and
preferences.
o Iterate on wireframes based on feedback and testing.

•
Figma Design:
o Design visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces in Figma.
o Ensure consistency with brand guidelines and design standards.
o Create interactive prototypes for testing and validation.

•
Collaboration:
o Work closely with developers, product managers, and other team members to
ensure seamless integration of design into development.
o Participate in design reviews and provide constructive feedback.

•
Stay Updated:
o Keep up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and best practices.


Education

•
Experience: 2+ years of experience in wireframing and UI design.

•

Skills
o Proficiency in Figma and other design tools.
o Strong understanding of UX principles and best practices.
o Ability to create visually appealing and user-friendly designs.
o Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
o Problem-solving and critical thinking abilities.

•
Portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating previous wireframing and design work.

Bonus Points

•
Experience with prototyping tools like InVision or Proto.io.

•
Knowledge of front-end development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).

•
Experience working in an agile development environment.
